pages.title: Layout
pages.text: Place the $(item)Draconic Reactor Core$() first. Then put four $(item)Reactor Stabilizers$() in a ring around it, all on one plane: north, south, east and west, or above, below and two sides. Each one must be in a straight line with the core, 4 to 7 blocks away, with nothing in between.
One of the two sides that are left takes a $(item)Reactor Energy Injector$(). You can put a second injector on the last side.

pages.title: Facing and linking
pages.text: Reactor parts face the player who places them, like a piston. Stand on the core side of the spot when you place each one, so its front points at the core. A part that faces the core links by itself; right-click any linked part to open the reactor screen.$(br2)The screen shows $(l)Invalid Setup$() until all four stabilizers face the core. Energy goes into the back of the injector and comes out of the back of each stabilizer.

pages.title: Keep it clear
pages.text: The core swells as it heats, to about 6 blocks across with a full load. Any block that ends up inside it slowly burns away. The 4-block minimum keeps the stabilizers and injectors outside that sphere; do not put anything else closer.$(br2)Plan the wiring for big numbers: a full-size reactor can move hundreds of thousands to millions of OP per tick. Use high-tier $(l:energy_network/crystals)Energy Crystals$(/l) or cables that can carry that much.
Stabilizer parts. JEI shows every recipe here too.
The rotor assembly combines both rotors.
